description: This file defines the SyntaxError class in the Twig templating engine, representing syntax error exceptions during template parsing.

classes.name: SyntaxError
classes.description: A class representing syntax error exceptions during lexing or parsing of Twig templates. It extends the Error class and provides a method to suggest similar strings when an error occurs.

methods.name: addSuggestions
methods.description: Adds suggested corrections to the error message based on a list of possible items, using string similarity metrics.
